citywide_and_regional.geography: City of Pittsburgh (permits) vs. 7-county Pittsburgh metro (Zillow)
evidence_agrees_on: Both measures of new construction declined between the two periods.
remains_uncertain: How much new-home activity changed: -11.0% (City permits) vs -45.1% (metro new-home sales).
possible_reasons: Different geography: the City of Pittsburgh vs. a 7-county metro area where most new homes are built outside the City.
Different stage of the pipeline: a permit is issued before construction; a new-construction sale happens after completion, often a year or more later.
Different units: permits do not record dwelling units; sales count homes.
